items.label: The immutable staging deployment identifies the exact release candidate.

Email/password recovery shows the same on-screen confirmation for a designated account and an unknown address, the designated reset action changes the password and returns to the canonical app URL, and provider evidence confirms email-enumeration protection plus the authorized continue domain.

The exact reviewed artifact exposes the public /start organization and owner form plus marketing CTA only with a syntactically valid non-placeholder public Turnstile site key; provider widget configuration and human review remain separately evidenced, initiation requires a fresh challenge, the page identifies the fixed $1 USD Stripe test invoice truthfully, QuotePilot collects no password or card data, and the return stays locked rather than granting application access.

The public initiation endpoint remains disabled until explicitly released, then accepts only a server-verified fresh Turnstile token for an exact approved hostname and action, enforces durable per-network and normalized-email-hash rate limits, uses deterministic idempotency to return one still-open invoice for a retry, and fails closed without leaking account or provider state.

Dedicated Firebase Secret Manager Stripe test credentials use a buyer-only Stripe client pinned to API version 2024-06-20 to create and finalize a true fixed $1 USD send_invoice invoice before payment and return only its Stripe Hosted Invoice Page; buyerAccessStripeWebhook is configured for and rejects events outside that same API version, accepts payment state only from the exact signed and replay-deduplicated buyer invoice lifecycle, buyer events cannot enter stripeWebhook or mutate the existing live quote client, API version, deposit, or final-balance rails, and provider evidence confirms the invoice page, endpoint version, and delivery path.

A matching paid buyer invoice prepares the server-owned organization, neutral settings, Starter workspace plan entitlements, provisioning record, controlled test-mode markers, audit evidence, and pending invitation but creates no user membership, admin role, custom claims, or application access; activation_sent is observed only after exact activation-instructions email provider acceptance is durably recorded, provider evidence separately confirms Firebase verification-email delivery and the authorized continue URL, and only an exact normalized verified invoice email consuming the unexpired invitation creates user access, while mismatch, failure, expiry, replay, and cross-account paths restore or grant no access and test records remain excluded from live revenue and paid-customer classification.

The browser pending surface displays truthful locked invoice, workspace-preparation, activation-instructions, and verified-email claim guidance; /app remains unavailable before server-confirmed user access and nonmatching or unverified identities receive no access. This browser observation does not claim onboarding-email provider acceptance, Firebase verification-email delivery, backend provisioning, role creation, or provider configuration.
A quote saves successfully.
Trusted pricing creates the draft quote, portal projection, and initial version.
An eligible edit is server-repriced and atomically updates quote, portal, and version state.
Terminal evidence blocks edit and reopen, sales cannot cross the allowed status boundary, and direct quote or portal deletion is denied.

The retired legacy bulk quote purge callable fails closed without mutation; permanent deletion within a retained organization remains one quote at a time through an exact approved delete_quote request.
The staff UI exposes no legacy bulk quote purge control.
The saved quote appears in Quote History and opens successfully.
Customer accept or decline updates the portal and organization quote consistently.
Provider acceptance for the exact current valid portal issuance records sent with a provider message id and activates only that issuance.
Provider acceptance for an invalid or expired portal issuance is retained as requires_rotation while that portal remains inactive until guarded rotation and a separate accepted send.

Copy Portal and the PDF portal link expose only an exact current valid issuance with matching provider acceptance; draft, invalid, expired, and newly rotated issuances remain withheld until separately accepted.

An exact approved request executes only its matching sensitive action, writes the server-owned organization-scoped outcome audit, and a completed replay returns the stored result without executing again.

An accepted quote converts through the exact approved server action to one booked contract with a server-owned contract number and availability result; an unapproved or mismatched conversion fails closed.

An exact approved deposit request binds the current quote, portal, customer, amount, and currency; Checkout stays private until durable provider-email acceptance publishes one link, ambiguous retry reuses the same provider identities, and definite failure neutralizes the unsent Session before replacement.

A booked contract with a provider-paid deposit collects only the server-derived remaining balance through its own exact approval, checkout generation, ledger entry, and final-balance projection; stale scope or missing prerequisites fail closed.

Signed and replay-deduplicated completed, async-success, async-failure, and expired Checkout events plus admin reconciliation apply only provider-observed truth, accept valid late settlement, and never downgrade paid or refunded state.
Deposit and final-balance metadata, Session scope, ledger entries, reconciliation, and webhook handling remain isolated so an event or browser request cannot mutate the other payment rail.

The customer portal projection publishes only customer-safe deposit and final-balance state and an accepted eligible link, without Stripe Session, operation, known-Session, or private-dispatch identifiers.

Staff surfaces expose only eligible deposit and final-balance send, resume, and reconcile actions, while the customer portal renders each rail independently and never exposes an unpublished link or private provider identifier.
The proposal PDF exports successfully with customer-safe content.
Integrations Ops loads and reports provider configuration truthfully.
With SMS disabled, the SMS test reports disabled or not configured without blocking the core quote flow.
